title: GTA 6 Leaker Threatens Story Mode Release in Crypto Scheme
description: A GTA 6 leaker threatens to release a full story mode build as part of a heavily criticized crypto scheme, according to IGN Games.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Faces New Threats: Leaker Puts Story Mode and Lucia's Clothing into Crypto Scheme

The anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster remains at an all-time high, but the title continues to face unwanted attention from actors within the underground scene. According to a recent report by IGN Games, a notorious GTA 6 leaker has made severe threats regarding the game's unreleased content, stirring widespread controversy across the gaming community.

### The Threat of a Full Story Mode Build Release

Reports indicate that the individual is threatening to release a build of the game featuring the full story mode played completely to the end. For a franchise renowned for its cinematic storytelling and closely guarded narrative twists, the prospect of a complete story walkthrough leak is a concerning development for both the developers and dedicated fans eagerly awaiting the title's launch.

### Backlash Over the Crypto Scheme

What makes this situation particularly egregious is the motivation behind the threats. The leaker has reportedly tied this potential release directly to a heavily criticized crypto scheme. Industry observers note that leveraging the massive hype surrounding GTA 6 to promote or manipulate cryptocurrency projects is a manipulative tactic designed to exploit passionate gamers for financial gain.

While the veracity of the claimed build and the true extent of the leak remain subjects of ongoing media scrutiny, the gaming community has largely condemned these actions. As we await official updates from Rockstar Games, players and content creators alike are being urged to steer clear of malicious spoilers and dubious financial schemes.

## Editor's Take

Weaponizing game leaks and story spoilers for a cheap cryptocurrency scheme is a low blow. True fans should ignore these manipulative tactics and wait to experience GTA 6 the way it was meant to be played.
